subsections.title: Selected Work
subsections.intro: Production systems delivered for real client and operational use.

cases.title: LG Energy Solution — Talent Data Automation
cases.description: Replaced manual candidate data collection by building an AI-driven system that navigates complex websites, extracts structured data, and delivers consistent outputs for internal talent sourcing and data processing operations. The system automated a previously manual workflow and improved both speed and data consistency at scale.

cases.title: AI-powered Legal & Tax Document Search
cases.description: Reduced time-intensive legal document search for a tax professional client by building an AI system that understands queries, retrieves relevant materials, and filters results before delivery. Search time was reduced from up to 5 hours to under 40 minutes, significantly improving workflow efficiency.

cases.title: Scenera (TnM AI) — Enterprise AI Systems
cases.description: Delivered multiple AI systems for enterprise clients across data access, IoT pipelines, video analytics, predictive maintenance, and edge deployment. These systems reduced manual operations and enabled production-level automation across different operational environments.

cases.title: 2asy.ai — Automated AI Content Platform
cases.description: Built and operate a fully automated AI system that collects, summarizes, translates, and publishes economic news. The system runs continuously with zero manual intervention, demonstrating reliable end-to-end automation in production.

content.intro: I work best where AI can replace real manual workflows and be deployed into actual operations.

fit.heading: When this is a good fit
fit.description: Teams spending too much time on manual data collection, document search, review, extraction, or repetitive operational workflows. Enterprise or professional clients who need a production-ready system and want one accountable owner from design to deployment.

nonfit.heading: When this may not be a fit
nonfit.description: Projects centered only on research, experimentation, or vague exploration without a clear workflow, operational problem, or deployment goal may be better served elsewhere.

content.intro: If your team is spending too much time on manual data, search, or document workflows, I can help design and deliver a production-ready AI system that replaces those processes with reliable automation.
